i.norm: A GroupedRandomAccessSource concatenates several underlying sources end to end. This test groups eight sources, each backed by a 7-byte (all-zero) buffer, and verifies that: - the group's total length is the sum of the parts (8 * 7 = 56), and - reading the very first byte returns 0 (the default value of an empty byte array).
All eight grouped sources share the same 7-byte zero-filled backing buffer.
Build a mix of the three wrapper types; only their lengths matter for the assertions.
